grammar.summary: 本课学习过去进行时与 after/before 时序，复习就餐场景。

points.title: after + 动作完成的时序表达
points.explanation: After I had had lunch at a village pub, I looked for my bag. 过去完成时表先于 look 发生。after/before 是过去完成时最常见的语境。

examples.en: After I had finished my drink, I went out.
examples.cn: 我喝完饮料后走了出去。

points.title: leave 与 forget 辨析
points.explanation: leave 表"把东西落在某处"（I left my bag there）；forget 表忘记做某事或忘记带（忘了拿东西用 leave 更准确）。

examples.en: I had left my bag on the chair beside the door.
examples.cn: 我把包落在门边的椅子上了。

exercises.q: Will the person who took my ruler please give it ___ to me?
When my children grew up, I gave all their toys ___ .
When do we have to give ___ our composition?
We were losing the battle but we did not give ___.
